title: Sync from live asks the live site first whether it moved, reads only what moved, and no longer stops on Joomla's scheduler log
expect: S1: every test passes; with table checksums the database is read once and a table that moved is read again alone; a matching fingerprint answers unchanged with no table or file asked for; the cheap listing hashes only files whose size or mtime moved; db.dump_many cut differently on two reads agrees; an older engine's read that brought nothing new answers unchanged; scheduler_logs rows both sites added keep the copy's

selectors.host: live-pull.mjs abilities pullMany pullDatabase listCheap fingerprintNow, webroot-sync.sh answer_unchanged, live_sync.py appendTables

fence: A sync of a live site that did not move never merges or restores anything, and a sync never stops on a log row both sites wrote
